caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a wooden dressing mirror stand set against a plain, light beige or cream background. The structure consists of a central vertical pole, primarily brown in color with brass or golden accents, rising from a tripod base with three curved legs that rest on the ground. Midway up the pole, there is a flat, horizontal, rectangular platform or shelf projecting outward. Above the shelf, an oval-shaped mirror or panel is mounted vertically, displaying a rich reddish-brown wood grain. The pole continues upward behind the mirror, terminating in a decorative finial. The object is centered in the drawing, with no additional items or background details present.
title: Pole Screen and Candlestand
